description: Daily large-block notional (Tier-3 proxy, mm_proxy_criteria_report.md §5.2): sum of futures aggTrades notional above the day's 99.9th percentile
known_limitations: threshold is the day's own 99.9th percentile of trade notional from a strided sample (max 250k trades/day) — the criteria report specifies a rolling 30d window; day-level percentile is the computable approximation
futures UM tape only (spot tape not collected)
Tier-3 proxy: aggregated retail routed through one API key can mimic block trades
